title: Orchestra Host Configuration
description: Configuration for an Orchestra host (orchestra.json). Discovered in this order, first match wins: $ORCHESTRA_CONFIG_PATH, then a project-local file found by walking up from the working directory (./orchestra.json then ./.orchestra/orchestra.json at each level, stopping at a repository root), then $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/Orchestra/orchestra.json, then %APPDATA%\Orchestra\orchestra.json (Windows) or ~/.config/Orchestra/orchestra.json. Every property is optional; Orchestra runs with no configuration file at all. The loader tolerates // comments and trailing commas, and expands ${VAR} / "env:VAR" references against the process environment (a missing variable is a hard error).

urls.description: Kestrel URL binding for the host, semicolon-separated for multiple. Applied only when no --urls argument, ASPNETCORE_URLS, or DOTNET_URLS is present. Example: "http://localhost:5000".

hostBaseUrl.description: Base URL that CLI client commands target when neither --server nor $ORCHESTRA_URL is set. Also used by run/exec to decide whether a running instance exists before spawning a throwaway host.

dataPath.description: Root directory for run history, the orchestration registry, checkpoints, and pending human-input records. Relative paths resolve against the directory holding this file. Default: %LOCALAPPDATA%/OrchestraHost (or the platform equivalent).

scan.description: Workspace directory scanned for orchestrations and profiles.

retention.description: Run-history retention. Omit for unlimited. Favorited runs are always exempt.

shutdownTimeoutSeconds.description: Grace period for in-flight work when the host stops. Default: 30.

autoResumeCheckpointsOnStartup.description: Resume checkpointed runs when the host starts. Default: true.

enableScheduler.description: Run the trigger scheduler. Set false for an API-only host that never fires triggers on its own. Default: true.

logLevel.description: Default minimum log level. Overrides Logging:LogLevel:Default from appsettings.json. An unrecognized value is ignored rather than applied. Default: Information.

defaultModel.description: Model used by Prompt steps that set no model and belong to an orchestration with no defaultModel.

provider.description: Default agent provider for Prompt steps. Resolution per step: step provider -> orchestration defaultProvider -> this value. Default: copilot.

defaultProvider.description: Alias for 'provider'. When both are set, 'provider' wins.

agentPool.description: Provider worker-pool capacity, applied to whichever provider is in use.

mcpServer.description: The MCP server Orchestra exposes, letting other agents discover and invoke your orchestrations.

polling.description: Portal poll intervals, surfaced to the UI.

sse.description: Server-sent events limits for live run streaming.

hooks.description: Global lifecycle hooks applied to every orchestration, in addition to any the orchestration declares. Relative scriptFile / workingDirectory paths resolve against this file's directory.

scan.description: Workspace scanning. NOTE: 'directory' is the workspace ROOT, not the orchestrations folder -- the host looks for 'orchestrations/' and 'profiles/' subdirectories inside it.

directory.description: Workspace root containing 'orchestrations/' and/or 'profiles/'. Relative paths resolve against this file's directory; "." means the directory holding this file. Without it nothing is scanned and watch/recursive have no effect.

watch.description: Re-register orchestrations and profiles as files change on disk. Default: false.

recursive.description: Scan subdirectories of 'orchestrations/' and 'profiles/'. Default: false.

maxRunsPerOrchestration.description: Keep at most this many runs per orchestration. 0 or omitted means unlimited.

maxRunAgeDays.description: Delete runs older than this many days. 0 or omitted means never.

minInstances.description: Workers kept ready. 0 disables prewarming, so the provider starts on the first Prompt step instead of at run start. Default: 1.

maxSessionsPerInstance.description: Concurrent prompt sessions per worker. Default: 1.

idleTimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds an idle worker above minInstances stays alive. 0 disables idle shrink. Default: 120.

gitHubToken.description: Token used for Copilot authentication. Prefer "${GITHUB_TOKEN}" over a literal. When unset, the Copilot CLI's stored credentials are used.

useLoggedInUser.description: Use the Copilot CLI's signed-in user rather than a token.

mcpStartupTimeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for a step's MCP servers to start. Default: 120.

swap.description: Worker swap-and-resume behaviour after a transient CLI transport failure.

budgetPerStep.description: Worker swaps allowed per step before the step fails. Default: 3.

resumeOnSwap.description: Resume the existing session on the new worker instead of starting over. Default: true.

resumeAlreadyInUseWaitSeconds.description: Grace period for a dying worker to release its session lock. Default: 5.

resumeAlreadyInUsePollIntervalMs.description: Poll interval while waiting for that lock. Default: 500.

cliPath.description: Path to the 'opencode' binary. Overrides $ORCHESTRA_OPENCODE_PATH. When unset, 'opencode' is resolved from PATH. Orchestra never downloads OpenCode.

hostname.description: Interface the spawned 'opencode serve' binds to. Default: 127.0.0.1.

serverUsername.description: Basic-auth username for the spawned server. Default: opencode.

serverPassword.description: Basic-auth password for the spawned server. Prefer "${VAR}" over a literal.

fallbackProvider.description: Provider prefix applied to unqualified model ids. Without it a bare model id such as 'claude-opus-4.8' fails; use a qualified id like 'github-copilot/claude-opus-4.8' instead. Default: github-copilot.

startupTimeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for the spawned server to report healthy. Default: 60.

engineToolBridgeEnabled.description: Expose Orchestra's engine tools to OpenCode over a loopback MCP endpoint. Default: true.

swapBudgetPerStep.description: Worker swaps allowed per step. Default: 1.

resumeOnSwapEnabled.description: Resume the session after a swap. Default: true.

dataPlaneEnabled.description: Expose the data plane, which lets other agents list and invoke orchestrations. Default: true.

controlPlaneEnabled.description: Expose the control plane, which can register and modify orchestrations. Opt-in because it is a write surface. Default: false -- an orchestration referencing this endpoint gets a 404 until it is turned on.

maxNestingDepth.description: Maximum depth of orchestrations invoking orchestrations, guarding against runaway recursion. Default: 5.

defaultOrchestraInvokeTimeoutSeconds.description: Client transport timeout for orchestra_* tool calls. 0 disables it. Default: 0.

defaultMcpToolCallTimeoutSeconds.description: Default per-tool-call timeout. When unset the MCP SDK's own default (~180s) applies.

defaultInvokeOrchestrationSyncTimeoutSec.description: How long a synchronous invoke_orchestration call waits for the child run. Default: 300.

toolDiscoveryProbeTimeoutSeconds.description: Timeout for the pre-flight probe that checks an MCP server returns tools. Default: 5.

endpointReachabilityProbeTimeoutSeconds.description: Timeout for the remote-MCP reachability probe. Default: 2.

maxAccumulatedEvents.description: Events retained per run for late subscribers. Default: 50000.

heartbeatIntervalSeconds.description: Keepalive interval, which stops idle proxies dropping the stream. Default: 20.
